work_item_linked.description: The work session names the Story or Bug it implements.
work_item_linked.how: run `harness work-session link --work-item <key>` for the Story or Bug being implemented

tasks_parented.description: The tracker holds at least one Task under that Story or Bug, and every Task under it names it as parent.
tasks_parented.how: break the Story or Bug down into Tasks in the selected tracker

plan_approved.description: An implementation plan for that Story or Bug was approved and has not changed since.
plan_approved.how: save the Story's implementation plan and have the user approve it with implementation-confirm, as generate-breakdown-work-items does before proposing Tasks

work_item_started.description: The tracker holds that Story or Bug, and it is in progress.
work_item_started.how: start the Story or Bug so the tracker shows it in progress

tests_with_code.description: Source files changed since the work item was linked come with changed tests, as the settings' tests_required pairs them.
tests_with_code.how: add or update the tests that cover the changed source files

checks_passed.description: Every configured check that applies to the changed files passed on the code as it is now.
checks_passed.how: run the project's checks with scripts/harness/checks.py and fix what fails

guarded_paths_verified.description: Each changed guarded path has its evidence for the code as it is now: its check passed, or the user confirmed it by hand.
guarded_paths_verified.how: run the guarded path's check, or show the change to the user and record their manual confirmation

review_ready.description: The review stage recorded a `ready` verdict for the code as it is now.
review_ready.how: run the review stage; it records the verdict with scripts/harness/review_verdict.py

verification_recorded.description: The tracker holds a verification artifact for the work item.
verification_recorded.how: publish the verification evidence to the work item

resolution_reported.description: The tracker holds a resolution report for the work item.
resolution_reported.how: publish the resolution report to the work item

pull_request_linked.description: When the user chose Git-based delivery with a remote repository host, the work item links its pull request.
pull_request_linked.how: open the draft pull request and link it to the work item
